_comment: Provenance for this package's testdata. Mirrors ../../codex/testdata/MANIFEST.json's discipline (memory 'silent-no-op-failure-mode': assert on real payload content, never just entry counts) and the top-level ../../../testdata/fixtures/MANIFEST.json's.

transcript-fixture.jsonl.real_source: ~/.claude/projects/-home-babbitt-workspace-ctxloom-ctxloom-main/63147910-550b-4758-b183-91bdd614e267.jsonl (a real interactive claude-code session on this box: a Finder/Researcher subagent doing a docs truthfulness audit, interrupted mid-tool-call by the user).
transcript-fixture.jsonl.real_fields: session id (63147910-550b-4758-b183-91bdd614e267), model (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001), permissionMode (default), the real thinking block's text, the real assistant reply text, both Glob/Bash tool_use blocks (exact id/name/input), both tool_result blocks (exact tool_use_id, exact output text including the is_error:true rejection message), the trailing '[Request interrupted by user for tool use]' text, and every usage block (input/output/cache tokens) on every assistant line in the file — all copied byte-for-byte from the real capture.
transcript-fixture.jsonl.shortened: the first Glob tool_result's file-listing content (originally ~100 real file paths, trimmed to 2 plus the real '(Results are truncated...)' suffix claude itself appends) and the thinking block's 'signature' field (an opaque, multi-KB base64 blob this adapter never reads — truncated for file size only, same treatment codex's own testdata gives its unread fields).
transcript-fixture.jsonl.synthetic_lines_added_for_coverage: three ADMINISTRATIVE lines with no conversational content — a queue-operation, a progress/hook_progress notice, and a system/turn_duration notice — assembled from the SAME real session's other lines (this box's actual capture has many more of each; three representative ones were selected, not fabricated shapes) to exercise the adapter's 'skip every non-user/non-assistant type' path. One isMeta:true 'user' line (claude's own <local-command-caveat> wrapper) was likewise copied from a real capture elsewhere in this box's ~/.claude/projects/ tree (the literal wrapper text claude emits verbatim for every local-command invocation observed) and inserted to exercise the isMeta skip path — the real source session for THIS particular fixture never triggered a local command, so no isMeta line existed inline to reuse as-is.
transcript-fixture.jsonl.why_not_fully_real: the real file additionally contains ~90KB of session-start/injected-skill/system-prompt text on its first real 'user' line (a bundled skill body + ltk/taskloom/rtk reference material) that this adapter treats as opaque conversational text; copying it verbatim would make this fixture anything but small and tight, mirroring codex's own rollout-fixture.jsonl precedent for the same reason. The paraphrase used here ('GOAL: Truthfulness audit...') is a shortened extract of the SAME real message's own tail (its actual task-specific instructions, after the boilerplate skill material), not fabricated prose.

turn-boundary-fixture.jsonl.real_source: ~/.claude/projects/-home-babbitt-workspace-ctxloom-ctxloom-main/1e8424bf-c7d2-45c2-b24e-01e7e293af18.jsonl — a DIFFERENT real session on this box (an agentcoord connectivity-check turn) from transcript-fixture.jsonl's, chosen specifically because it completed two full model turns with distinct message.id values and real stop_reason fields ('tool_use' then 'end_turn') — transcript-fixture.jsonl's own source session never got that far (user-interrupted mid-turn, see above), so it cannot exercise the mid-stream Complete-boundary-on-id-change path this file exists to cover.
turn-boundary-fixture.jsonl.real_fields: both message.id values (msg_011CcuBHGRxTPBSA1Ew8v98E, msg_011CcuBTRGoK1FUXgWwUwZNm), both stop_reason values, the ToolSearch tool_use call (exact id/name/input), the real assistant reply text, and every usage block's real token counts (input/output/cache_read/cache_creation) — all copied byte-for-byte, and independently pinned by TestConvert_TurnBoundaryOnMessageIDChange.
turn-boundary-fixture.jsonl.shortened: each thinking block's 'signature' field (truncated, same treatment as transcript-fixture.jsonl's) and the final assistant reply's text (trimmed to a shorter paraphrase of the same real message, which ran several paragraphs). Several usage sub-fields this adapter never reads (server_tool_use, cache_creation's nested ephemeral breakdown, iterations, speed, inference_geo, diagnostics, attributionMcpServer/Tool, requestId's duplicate parentUuid chain) were dropped entirely to keep the file small — every field the adapter DOES read is present and real.

golden.transcript.acp.jsonl.provenance: NOT hand-written — generated by running claude.Adapter{}.Convert against transcript-fixture.jsonl and capturing the Recorder's output verbatim (see claude_test.go's TestConvert_MatchesGolden, which re-generates and diffs against this file on every run — it is a checked-in expectation, not a separate hand-maintained parallel format).
golden.transcript.acp.jsonl.harp/seq/ts: harp and ts are stamped by the test's Recorder construction (NewRecorder's clock is not caller-configurable) — ts reflects wall-clock test-run time, so the golden comparison in claude_test.go zeroes/ignores ts rather than pinning it; seq is deterministic (0..N in file order) and IS asserted verbatim.

mapping_test.go's inline payloads.provenance: A handful of small structural cases (empty content, empty thinking, tool_use with no input) need no real source — they are the degenerate/zero-value shape, not a distinct real payload variant. The tool_result array-content case (text + tool_reference + image elements) is SHAPED from a real tool_result content array observed on this box (an MCP tool-listing result), with its exact tool_name/values shortened/redacted rather than copied verbatim, since the point under test is the DROP behavior for non-text element types, not those elements' own content. The sidechain-propagation fixture in mapping_test.go is a shortened copy of a real subagent capture at ~/.claude/projects/-home-babbitt-workspace-ctxloom-ctxloom-main/10d9f2b3-7e75-4794-8fea-54b4143dbf6d/subagents/agent-a0f0c165cd7295cfd.jsonl line 3 (real message.id, real tool_use id/name, real input command text, real usage counts).
